note: The Pavement, correcting itself, plus two facts The Legend and any future scene work need. ONE, MY ERROR, RECORDED BECAUSE THE SHAPE REPEATS. I was told scene/tiles-region/v1 had gained relief and relief_legend fields. I verified it by grepping THE REPORTING BRANCH WORKTREE, which correctly established that ITS branch carries them, then wrote it into a spec and a task brief as a fact about the tree my own campaign builds on. It is not there. Checked three ways: campaign/the-pavement has drainage then precip_mm_yr and no relief; main the same; only campaign/the-legend carries relief and relief_legend. The reporter was right about its own branch. I verified a NEIGHBOURING proposition and used the answer for the one that mattered. Second instance of that shape in one session for me; the first was reading a hook comment as if it outranked a standing user instruction. The lesson is narrow and mechanical: when a peer reports a fact about a shared file, grep YOUR OWN tree before writing it down, because the peer is describing a branch and you are describing yours. TWO, region.rs no longer owns a projection. Its private cube-face basis and projection are gone; it calls hornvale_kernel::cube. The projection is now TANGENT-WARPED, a prime equals tan of a times pi over four, which is the fix for the 5.2x area distortion the naive normalize carries. Consequence for anyone holding a RegionAddr: a given face, level, ix, iy, samples now addresses a different patch of sphere, so every per-node layer under it shifts and region fixtures move for that reason alone. THREE, warp of plus or minus one is special-cased to exactly plus or minus one. Pure tan of pi over four returns one ULP below 1.0, which left face seams watertight only to 1 ULP, measured 1.11e-16. Snapping the endpoints is exact because tan of pi over four genuinely IS one, monotonicity is preserved, and it changes geometry only at exact face edges where watertightness is load-bearing. Covered by a test that the same physical point reached from two adjoining faces gives byte-identical coordinates. FOUR, decision 0513 records that surrounds.rs w and up are permanently null on the wire because a quad has no barycentric third axis and no orientation flag, that u and v still carry values, and that 0356 retiring the external clients is why no version bump was forced.
